# Sun Modality Synthetic Fixtures — SYNTHETIC_TEST_ONLY

These files are generated by `_fixture_builder.py` for S2.1-B-R1. They are
not extracted from, sampled from, or schema-compatible evidence for the
official `EStG_sent_vec.csv`.

The synthetic adapter is exactly:

```text
source_id,text,label_definition,label_obligation,label_permission,label_prohibition
```

It uses a header plus four strict-one-hot label columns. This is test-only.

`synthetic_headerless_integer.csv` is a separate four-column, headerless
fixture for the explicit integer-code adapter seam. It is deliberately not a
model of the official CSV: the full S2.1-C scan proved that the official file
has no integer modality-code column. The fixture exists only to verify that a
supplied mapping works and that missing/unknown mappings fail closed.
The official CSV schema, official label mode, and integer code 0–3 mapping
remain `pending_s2_1_c`; S2.1-B-R1 does not guess that mapping.

| File | Purpose | Expected behavior |
|---|---|---|
| `synthetic_normal.csv` | Ordinary rows with unique explicit source IDs | clean ingest |
| `synthetic_large_normal.csv` | Ten normalized-text groups per class | deterministic seed tests |
| `synthetic_empty_text.csv` | One empty text | row rejected as empty; no other row dropped |
| `synthetic_duplicate_id.csv` | Two different rows reuse `duplicate-source-001` | fail closed with `duplicate_source_id`; no manifest |
| `synthetic_duplicate_text_same_label.csv` | Three groups per class, two distinct source IDs per group | each group is indivisible and never crosses split |
| `synthetic_duplicate_text_conflicting_label.csv` | One normalized text maps to two labels | fail closed with `label_conflict`; no manifest |
| `synthetic_no_source_id.csv` | Deliberately omits the ID column | succeeds only when `id_column=None`; manifest records row-index fallback |
| `synthetic_cross_split_leakage.csv` | Legacy filename containing same-label duplicate-text groups | succeeds under R1; post-check reports no leakage |
| `synthetic_small_class.csv` | One class below the 3-group threshold | entire class goes to train with the exact threshold warning |
| remaining one-hot/schema fixtures | all-zero, multi-hot, non-binary, missing label column, NUL text | strict synthetic-adapter negative cases |

The only small-class threshold is:

```text
active_nonzero_splits * min_per_class_in_smallest_split
```

With train/dev/test active and `min=1`, the threshold is exactly 3 groups.
Two groups go train-only with a warning; three or four groups receive at
least one group in every split. No class, group, or record is discarded.
